<p>过去一年，我花了无数个夜晚，在一次次打磨与推翻中，完成了自己最满意的作品 —— Art Design Pro。</p>
<p>这不是一个普通的后台模板。<br>
它是一场关于 「设计美学」与「工程化开发」 的融合实验——<br>
希望让后台系统不再冰冷枯燥，而是像一件作品：优雅、流畅、有温度。</p>
<h2 data-id="heading-0">为什么要做这个项目？</h2>
<p>在日常开发中，我几乎体验过所有主流后台模板。<br>
它们的功能确实完整，但更多时候给人的感觉是——「工具」而非「产品」。</p>
<p>我希望做一个后台系统，<br>
让人打开的第一眼就觉得舒服，<br>
用起来像是在和它对话。</p>
<p>许多后台系统普遍存在这些问题 👇</p>
<p><strong>视觉疲劳</strong>：灰白配色、生硬布局，难以长时间使用；</p>
<p><strong>体验割裂</strong>：逻辑不统一、入口分散，操作效率低；</p>
<p><strong>复用困难</strong>：组件风格不一致，二次开发成本高。</p>
<p>于是我决定从零开始，花一年的时间去打造一个真正属于自己的系统——<br>
👉 一款 “既好看、又好用，还能直接用于商业项目” 的后台管理模板。</p>
<h2 data-id="heading-1">项目简介：Art Design Pro</h2>
<p>Art Design Pro 是一款基于 Vue 3 + TypeScript + Vite + Element Plus 打造的现代化后台管理系统模板。</p>
<p>它的核心理念是：</p>
<blockquote>
<p>让后台系统兼具设计美学与开发效率。</p>
</blockquote>
<h2 data-id="heading-2">这个项目有什么特别的呢？</h2>
<p><strong>界面设计</strong>：现代化 UI 设计，流畅交互，以用户体验与视觉设计为核心</p>
<p><strong>极速上手</strong>：简洁架构 + 完整文档，后端开发者也能轻松使用</p>
<p><strong>丰富组件</strong>：内置数据展示、表单等多种高质量组件，满足不同业务场景的需求</p>
<p><strong>丝滑交互</strong>：按钮点击、主题切换、页面过渡、图表动画，体验媲美商业产品</p>
<p><strong>高效开发</strong>：内置 useTable、ArtForm 等实用 API，显著提升开发效率</p>
<p><strong>精简脚本</strong>：内置一键清理脚本，可快速清理演示数据，立即得到可开发的基础项目</p>
<h2 data-id="heading-3">技术栈</h2>
<p>开发框架：Vue3、TypeScript、Vite、Element-Plus</p>
<p>代码规范：Eslint、Prettier、Stylelint、Husky、Lint-staged、cz-git</p>

<h2 data-id="heading-7">高效开发</h2>
<blockquote>
<p>在后台管理系统开发中，表格页面占据了 80% 的工作量。每次都要写分页、搜索、刷新、列配置...这些重复的代码让人头疼。今天分享一套我们团队正在使用的表格开发方案，让你的开发效率提升 10 倍！</p>
</blockquote>
<h2 data-id="heading-8">痛点分析</h2>
<p>在开发后台管理系统时，你是否遇到过这些问题：</p>
<ul>
<li>每个表格页面都要写一遍分页逻辑</li>
<li>搜索、重置、刷新等功能重复实现</li>
<li>表格列配置、显示隐藏、拖拽排序需要手动处理</li>
<li>数据请求、loading 状态、错误处理代码冗余</li>
<li>缓存策略难以统一管理</li>
<li>移动端适配需要额外处理</li>
</ul>
<p>如果你的答案是"是"，那这篇文章就是为你准备的。</p>
<h2 data-id="heading-9">解决方案概览</h2>
<p>我们的方案包含以下核心部分：</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>useTable</strong> - 强大的表格数据管理 Hook</li>
<li><strong>ArtTable</strong> - 增强的表格组件</li>
<li><strong>ArtTableHeader</strong> - 表格工具栏组件</li>
<li><strong>ArtSearchBar</strong> - 智能搜索栏组件</li>
<li><strong>ArtForm</strong> - 通用表单组件</li>
</ul>
<h2 data-id="heading-10">一、useTable：表格数据管理的核心</h2>
<h3 data-id="heading-11">1.1 基础用法</h3>
<p>先看一个最简单的例子，只需要几行代码就能实现一个完整的表格：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-typescript" lang="typescript"><span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> {
  data,
  columns,
  columnChecks,
  loading,
  pagination,
  refreshData,
  handleSizeChange,
  handleCurrentChange
} = <span class="hljs-title function_">useTable</span>({
  <span class="hljs-attr">core</span>: {
    <span class="hljs-attr">apiFn</span>: fetchGetUserList,
    <span class="hljs-attr">apiParams</span>: {
      <span class="hljs-attr">current</span>: <span class="hljs-number">1</span>,
      <span class="hljs-attr">size</span>: <span class="hljs-number">20</span>
    },
    <span class="hljs-attr">columnsFactory</span>: <span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> [
      { <span class="hljs-attr">prop</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'id'</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">label</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'ID'</span> },
      { <span class="hljs-attr">prop</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'userName'</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">label</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'用户名'</span> },
      { <span class="hljs-attr">prop</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'userPhone'</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">label</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'手机号'</span> }
    ]
  }
})
</code></pre>
<p>就这么简单！你已经拥有了：</p>
<ul>
<li>✅ 自动的数据请求</li>
<li>✅ 分页功能</li>
<li>✅ Loading 状态</li>
<li>✅ 列配置管理</li>
</ul>
<h3 data-id="heading-12">1.2 核心特性</h3>
<h4 data-id="heading-13">🚀 智能缓存机制</h4>
<pre><code class="hljs language-typescript" lang="typescript"><span class="hljs-title function_">useTable</span>({
  <span class="hljs-attr">core</span>: {
    <span class="hljs-comment">/* ... */</span>
  },
  <span class="hljs-attr">performance</span>: {
    <span class="hljs-attr">enableCache</span>: <span class="hljs-literal">true</span>, <span class="hljs-comment">// 启用缓存</span>
    <span class="hljs-attr">cacheTime</span>: <span class="hljs-number">5</span> * <span class="hljs-number">60</span> * <span class="hljs-number">1000</span>, <span class="hljs-comment">// 缓存 5 分钟</span>
    <span class="hljs-attr">debounceTime</span>: <span class="hljs-number">300</span>, <span class="hljs-comment">// 防抖 300ms</span>
    <span class="hljs-attr">maxCacheSize</span>: <span class="hljs-number">50</span> <span class="hljs-comment">// 最多缓存 50 条</span>
  }
})
</code></pre>
<p>缓存带来的好处：</p>
<ul>
<li>相同参数的请求直接从缓存读取，秒开</li>
<li>减少服务器压力</li>
<li>提升用户体验</li>
</ul>
<h4 data-id="heading-14">🎯 多种刷新策略</h4>
<p>不同的业务场景需要不同的刷新策略：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-typescript" lang="typescript"><span class="hljs-comment">// 新增数据后：回到第一页，清空分页缓存</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">refreshCreate</span>()

<span class="hljs-comment">// 编辑数据后：保持当前页，只清空当前搜索缓存</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">refreshUpdate</span>()

<span class="hljs-comment">// 删除数据后：智能处理页码，避免空页面</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">refreshRemove</span>()

<span class="hljs-comment">// 手动刷新：清空所有缓存</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">refreshData</span>()

<span class="hljs-comment">// 定时刷新：轻量刷新，保持分页状态</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">refreshSoft</span>()
</code></pre>
<p>这些方法让你的代码更语义化，不用再纠结什么时候该清缓存。</p>
<h4 data-id="heading-15">🔄 数据转换器</h4>
<p>有时候接口返回的数据需要处理一下才能用：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-typescript" lang="typescript"><span class="hljs-title function_">useTable</span>({
  <span class="hljs-attr">core</span>: {
    <span class="hljs-comment">/* ... */</span>
  },
  <span class="hljs-attr">transform</span>: {
    <span class="hljs-attr">dataTransformer</span>: <span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">records</span>) =&gt;</span> {
      <span class="hljs-keyword">return</span> records.<span class="hljs-title function_">map</span>(<span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">item, index</span>) =&gt;</span> ({
        ...item,
        <span class="hljs-comment">// 替换头像</span>
        <span class="hljs-attr">avatar</span>: localAvatars[index % localAvatars.<span class="hljs-property">length</span>].<span class="hljs-property">avatar</span>,
        <span class="hljs-comment">// 格式化日期</span>
        <span class="hljs-attr">createTime</span>: <span class="hljs-title function_">dayjs</span>(item.<span class="hljs-property">createTime</span>).<span class="hljs-title function_">format</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'YYYY-MM-DD'</span>)
      }))
    }
  }
})
</code></pre>
<h4 data-id="heading-16">📊 生命周期钩子</h4>
<pre><code class="hljs language-typescript" lang="typescript"><span class="hljs-title function_">useTable</span>({
  <span class="hljs-attr">core</span>: {
    <span class="hljs-comment">/* ... */</span>
  },
  <span class="hljs-attr">hooks</span>: {
    <span class="hljs-attr">onSuccess</span>: <span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">data, response</span>) =&gt;</span> {
      <span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'数据加载成功'</span>, data)
    },
    <span class="hljs-attr">onError</span>: <span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">error</span>) =&gt;</span> {
      <span class="hljs-title class_">ElMessage</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">error</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'加载失败：'</span> + error.<span class="hljs-property">message</span>)
    },
    <span class="hljs-attr">onCacheHit</span>: <span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">data</span>) =&gt;</span> {
      <span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'从缓存读取'</span>, data)
    }
  }
})
</code></pre>
<h3 data-id="heading-17">1.3 搜索功能</h3>
<p>搜索是表格的核心功能，useTable 提供了完善的搜索支持：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-typescript" lang="typescript"><span class="hljs-comment">// 定义搜索参数</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> searchParams = <span class="hljs-title function_">reactive</span>({
  <span class="hljs-attr">userName</span>: <span class="hljs-string">''</span>,
  <span class="hljs-attr">userPhone</span>: <span class="hljs-string">''</span>,
  <span class="hljs-attr">status</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'1'</span>
})

<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> { getData, resetSearchParams } = <span class="hljs-title function_">useTable</span>({
  <span class="hljs-attr">core</span>: {
    <span class="hljs-attr">apiFn</span>: fetchGetUserList,
    <span class="hljs-attr">apiParams</span>: searchParams
  }
})

<span class="hljs-comment">// 搜索</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">handleSearch</span> = (<span class="hljs-params">params</span>) =&gt; {
  <span class="hljs-title class_">Object</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">assign</span>(searchParams, params)
  <span class="hljs-title function_">getData</span>() <span class="hljs-comment">// 自动回到第一页</span>
}

<span class="hljs-comment">// 重置</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">handleReset</span> = (<span class="hljs-params"></span>) =&gt; {
  <span class="hljs-title function_">resetSearchParams</span>() <span class="hljs-comment">// 清空搜索条件并重新加载</span>
}
</code></pre>
<h2 data-id="heading-18">二、ArtTable：增强的表格组件</h2>
<h3 data-id="heading-19">2.1 核心特性</h3>
<p>ArtTable 基于 Element Plus 的 ElTable 封装，完全兼容原有 API，同时提供了更多增强功能：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-vue" lang="vue">&lt;ArtTable
  :loading="loading"
  :data="data"
  :columns="columns"
  :pagination="pagination"
  @selection-change="handleSelectionChange"
  @pagination:size-change="handleSizeChange"
  @pagination:current-change="handleCurrentChange"
/&gt;
</code></pre>
<h4 data-id="heading-20">✨ 自动高度计算</h4>
<p>不用再手动计算表格高度了！ArtTable 会自动计算剩余空间：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-vue" lang="vue">&lt;div class="art-full-height"&gt;
  &lt;UserSearch /&gt;
  &lt;ElCard class="art-table-card"&gt;
    &lt;ArtTableHeader /&gt;
    &lt;ArtTable /&gt; &lt;!-- 自动占满剩余高度 --&gt;
  &lt;/ElCard&gt;

&lt;/div&gt;

</code></pre>
<h4 data-id="heading-21">🎨 列配置灵活</h4>
<p>支持多种列类型和自定义渲染：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-typescript" lang="typescript"><span class="hljs-attr">columnsFactory</span>: <span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> [
  { <span class="hljs-attr">type</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'selection'</span> }, <span class="hljs-comment">// 勾选列</span>
  { <span class="hljs-attr">type</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'index'</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">width</span>: <span class="hljs-number">60</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">label</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'序号'</span> }, <span class="hljs-comment">// 序号列</span>
  { <span class="hljs-attr">type</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'globalIndex'</span> }, <span class="hljs-comment">// 全局序号（跨页）</span>

  <span class="hljs-comment">// 自定义渲染</span>

    <span class="hljs-attr">label</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'用户'</span>,

      ])
    }
  },

  <span class="hljs-comment">// 使用插槽</span>
  {
    <span class="hljs-attr">prop</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'status'</span>,
    <span class="hljs-attr">label</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'状态'</span>,
    <span class="hljs-attr">useSlot</span>: <span class="hljs-literal">true</span> <span class="hljs-comment">// 在模板中使用 #status 插槽</span>
  },

  <span class="hljs-comment">// 操作列</span>
  {
    <span class="hljs-attr">prop</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'operation'</span>,
    <span class="hljs-attr">label</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'操作'</span>,
    <span class="hljs-attr">fixed</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'right'</span>,
    <span class="hljs-attr">formatter</span>: <span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">row</span>) =&gt;</span>
      <span class="hljs-title function_">h</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'div'</span>, [
        <span class="hljs-title function_">h</span>(<span class="hljs-title class_">ArtButtonTable</span>, {
          <span class="hljs-attr">type</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'edit'</span>,
          <span class="hljs-attr">onClick</span>: <span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">handleEdit</span>(row)
        }),
        <span class="hljs-title function_">h</span>(<span class="hljs-title class_">ArtButtonTable</span>, {
          <span class="hljs-attr">type</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'delete'</span>,
          <span class="hljs-attr">onClick</span>: <span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">handleDelete</span>(row)
        })
      ])
  }
]
</code></pre>
<h4 data-id="heading-22">📱 响应式分页</h4>

<h2 data-id="heading-23">三、ArtTableHeader：强大的工具栏</h2>
<h3 data-id="heading-24">3.1 开箱即用的功能</h3>
<pre><code class="hljs language-vue" lang="vue">&lt;ArtTableHeader v-model:columns="columnChecks" :loading="loading" @refresh="refreshData"&gt;
  &lt;template #left&gt;
    &lt;ElButton @click="handleAdd"&gt;新增用户&lt;/ElButton&gt;

  &lt;/template&gt;

&lt;/ArtTableHeader&gt;

</code></pre>
<p>一行代码，你就拥有了：</p>
<ul>
<li>🔍 搜索栏切换</li>
<li>🔄 刷新按钮（带加载动画）</li>
<li>📏 表格尺寸切换（大、中、小）</li>
<li>🖥️ 全屏模式</li>
<li>📋 列显示/隐藏配置</li>
<li>🎨 斑马纹、边框、表头背景切换</li>
</ul>
<h3 data-id="heading-25">3.2 列配置功能</h3>
<p>用户可以：</p>
<ul>
<li>✅ 勾选显示/隐藏列</li>
<li>✅ 拖拽调整列顺序</li>
<li>✅ 固定列不可拖动</li>
</ul>
<p>这些配置会自动同步到表格显示。</p>
<h3 data-id="heading-26">3.3 自定义布局</h3>
<pre><code class="hljs language-vue" lang="vue">&lt;ArtTableHeader layout="refresh,size,fullscreen,columns" :show-zebra="false" :show-border="false" /&gt;
</code></pre>
<p>通过 <code>layout</code> 属性控制显示哪些功能按钮。</p>
<h2 data-id="heading-27">四、ArtSearchBar：智能搜索栏</h2>
<h3 data-id="heading-28">4.1 配置化搜索表单</h3>
<p>不用再手写一堆 ElFormItem 了，用配置就能搞定：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-vue" lang="vue">&lt;template&gt;
  &lt;ArtSearchBar
    ref="searchBarRef"
    v-model="formData"
    :items="formItems"
    :rules="rules"
    @reset="handleReset"
    @search="handleSearch"
  /&gt;
&lt;/template&gt;

&lt;script setup lang="ts"&gt;
  const formData = ref({
    userName: undefined,
    userPhone: undefined,
    status: '1'
  })

  const formItems = computed(() =&gt; [
    {
      label: '用户名',
      key: 'userName',
      type: 'input',
      placeholder: '请输入用户名',
      clearable: true
    },
    {
      label: '手机号',
      key: 'userPhone',
      type: 'input',
      props: { placeholder: '请输入手机号', maxlength: '11' }
    },
    {
      label: '状态',
      key: 'status',
      type: 'select',
      props: {
        placeholder: '请选择状态',
        options: [
          { label: '在线', value: '1' },
          { label: '离线', value: '2' }
        ]
      }
    },
    {
      label: '性别',
      key: 'userGender',
      type: 'radiogroup',
      props: {
        options: [
          { label: '男', value: '1' },
          { label: '女', value: '2' }
        ]
      }
    }
  ])

  const handleSearch = async () =&gt; {
    await searchBarRef.value.validate()
    emit('search', formData.value)
  }

  const handleReset = () =&gt; {
    emit('reset')
  }
&lt;/script&gt;

</code></pre>
<h3 data-id="heading-29">4.2 核心特性</h3>
<h4 data-id="heading-30">🎯 支持多种表单组件</h4>
<p>开箱即用的组件类型：</p>
<ul>
<li><code>input</code> - 输入框</li>
<li><code>select</code> - 下拉选择</li>
<li><code>date</code> / <code>datetime</code> / <code>daterange</code> - 日期选择</li>
<li><code>radiogroup</code> / <code>checkboxgroup</code> - 单选/多选</li>
<li><code>cascader</code> - 级联选择</li>
<li><code>treeselect</code> - 树选择</li>
<li>自定义组件 - 支持任意 Vue 组件</li>
</ul>
<h4 data-id="heading-31">📦 自动展开/收起</h4>
<p>当搜索项过多时，自动显示展开/收起按钮：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-vue" lang="vue">&lt;ArtSearchBar :items="formItems" :show-expand="true" :default-expanded="false" :span="6" /&gt;
</code></pre>
<ul>
<li>默认只显示一行</li>
<li>超出部分自动隐藏</li>
<li>点击"展开"查看全部搜索项</li>
</ul>
<h4 data-id="heading-32">🔄 动态选项加载</h4>
<p>支持异步加载选项数据：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-typescript" lang="typescript"><span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> statusOptions = <span class="hljs-title function_">ref</span>([])

<span class="hljs-title function_">onMounted</span>(<span class="hljs-keyword">async</span> () =&gt; {
  <span class="hljs-comment">// 模拟接口请求</span>
  statusOptions.<span class="hljs-property">value</span> = <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">fetchStatusOptions</span>()
})

<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> formItems = <span class="hljs-title function_">computed</span>(<span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> [
  {
    <span class="hljs-attr">label</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'状态'</span>,
    <span class="hljs-attr">key</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'status'</span>,
    <span class="hljs-attr">type</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'select'</span>,
    <span class="hljs-attr">props</span>: {
      <span class="hljs-attr">options</span>: statusOptions.<span class="hljs-property">value</span> <span class="hljs-comment">// 动态选项</span>
    }
  }
])
</code></pre>
<h4 data-id="heading-33">🎨 响应式布局</h4>
<p>自动适配不同屏幕尺寸：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-typescript" lang="typescript"><span class="hljs-comment">// 通过 span 控制每行显示的表单项数量</span>
<span class="hljs-comment">// span=6: 一行显示 4 个（24/6=4）</span>
<span class="hljs-comment">// span=8: 一行显示 3 个（24/8=3）</span>
<span class="hljs-comment">// span=12: 一行显示 2 个（24/12=2）</span>
</code></pre>
<p>移动端自动调整为单列布局。</p>
<h3 data-id="heading-34">4.3 表单校验</h3>
<p>支持完整的表单校验：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-typescript" lang="typescript"><span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> rules = {
  <span class="hljs-attr">userName</span>: [{ <span class="hljs-attr">required</span>: <span class="hljs-literal">true</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">message</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'请输入用户名'</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">trigger</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'blur'</span> }],
  <span class="hljs-attr">userPhone</span>: [
    { <span class="hljs-attr">required</span>: <span class="hljs-literal">true</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">message</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'请输入手机号'</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">trigger</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'blur'</span> },
    { <span class="hljs-attr">pattern</span>: <span class="hljs-regexp">/^1[3-9]\d{9}$/</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">message</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'手机号格式不正确'</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">trigger</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'blur'</span> }
  ]
}

<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">handleSearch</span> = <span class="hljs-keyword">async</span> (<span class="hljs-params"></span>) =&gt; {
  <span class="hljs-comment">// 校验通过才执行搜索</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> searchBarRef.<span class="hljs-property">value</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">validate</span>()
  <span class="hljs-title function_">emit</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'search'</span>, formData.<span class="hljs-property">value</span>)
}
</code></pre>
<h2 data-id="heading-35">五、ArtForm：通用表单组件</h2>
<h3 data-id="heading-36">5.1 配置化表单</h3>
<p>ArtForm 和 ArtSearchBar 使用相同的配置方式，但更适合弹窗、详情页等场景：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-vue" lang="vue">&lt;template&gt;
  &lt;ArtForm
    ref="formRef"
    v-model="formData"
    :items="formItems"
    :rules="formRules"
    :label-width="100"
    :span="12"
    @reset="handleReset"
    @submit="handleSubmit"
  /&gt;
&lt;/template&gt;

&lt;script setup lang="ts"&gt;
  const formData = ref({
    userName: '',
    userPhone: '',
    userEmail: '',
    userGender: '1',
    status: true
  })

  const formItems = [
    {
      label: '用户名',
      key: 'userName',
      type: 'input',
      placeholder: '请输入用户名'
    },
    {
      label: '手机号',
      key: 'userPhone',
      type: 'input',
      props: { maxlength: 11 }
    },
    {
      label: '邮箱',
      key: 'userEmail',
      type: 'input',
      placeholder: '请输入邮箱'
    },
    {
      label: '性别',
      key: 'userGender',
      type: 'radiogroup',
      props: {
        options: [
          { label: '男', value: '1' },
          { label: '女', value: '2' }
        ]
      }
    },
    {
      label: '是否启用',
      key: 'status',
      type: 'switch'
    },
    {
      label: '备注',
      key: 'remark',
      type: 'input',
      span: 24, // 占满整行
      props: {
        type: 'textarea',
        rows: 4
      }
    }
  ]

  const formRules = {
    userName: [{ required: true, message: '请输入用户名', trigger: 'blur' }],
    userEmail: [{ type: 'email', message: '邮箱格式不正确', trigger: 'blur' }]
  }

  const handleSubmit = async () =&gt; {
    await formRef.value.validate()
    // 提交表单
    console.log('表单数据:', formData.value)
  }
&lt;/script&gt;

</code></pre>
<h3 data-id="heading-37">5.2 高级特性</h3>
<h4 data-id="heading-38">🎨 自定义组件渲染</h4>
<p>支持使用 h 函数渲染任意组件：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-typescript" lang="typescript"><span class="hljs-keyword">import</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">ArtIconSelector</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">from</span> <span class="hljs-string">'@/components/core/base/art-icon-selector/index.vue'</span>

<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> formItems = [
  {
    <span class="hljs-attr">label</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'图标选择'</span>,
    <span class="hljs-attr">key</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'icon'</span>,
    <span class="hljs-attr">type</span>: <span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span>
      <span class="hljs-title function_">h</span>(<span class="hljs-title class_">ArtIconSelector</span>, {
        <span class="hljs-attr">iconType</span>: <span class="hljs-title class_">IconTypeEnum</span>.<span class="hljs-property">UNICODE</span>,
        <span class="hljs-attr">width</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'100%'</span>
      })
  },
  {
    <span class="hljs-attr">label</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'文件上传'</span>,
    <span class="hljs-attr">key</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'files'</span>,
    <span class="hljs-attr">type</span>: <span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span>
      <span class="hljs-title function_">h</span>(
        <span class="hljs-title class_">ElUpload</span>,
        {
          <span class="hljs-attr">action</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'#'</span>,
          <span class="hljs-attr">multiple</span>: <span class="hljs-literal">true</span>,
          <span class="hljs-attr">limit</span>: <span class="hljs-number">5</span>,
          <span class="hljs-attr">onChange</span>: <span class="hljs-function">(<span class="hljs-params">file, fileList</span>) =&gt;</span> {
            formData.<span class="hljs-property">value</span>.<span class="hljs-property">files</span> = fileList
          }
        },
        {
          <span class="hljs-attr">default</span>: <span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">h</span>(<span class="hljs-title class_">ElButton</span>, { <span class="hljs-attr">type</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'primary'</span> }, <span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> <span class="hljs-string">'点击上传'</span>)
        }
      )
  }
]
</code></pre>
<h4 data-id="heading-39">🔌 插槽支持</h4>
<p>支持为表单项添加插槽：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-vue" lang="vue">&lt;ArtForm v-model="formData" :items="formItems"&gt;
  &lt;template #customField&gt;
    &lt;div class="custom-content"&gt;
      &lt;!-- 自定义内容 --&gt;
    &lt;/div&gt;

  &lt;/template&gt;

&lt;/ArtForm&gt;

</code></pre>
<p>或者在配置中使用插槽：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-typescript" lang="typescript"><span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> formItems = [
  {
    <span class="hljs-attr">label</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'网站'</span>,
    <span class="hljs-attr">key</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'website'</span>,
    <span class="hljs-attr">type</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'input'</span>,
    <span class="hljs-attr">slots</span>: {
      <span class="hljs-attr">prepend</span>: <span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">h</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'span'</span>, <span class="hljs-string">'https://'</span>),
      <span class="hljs-attr">append</span>: <span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">h</span>(<span class="hljs-string">'span'</span>, <span class="hljs-string">'.com'</span>)
    }
  }
]
</code></pre>
<h4 data-id="heading-40">🎯 条件显示</h4>
<p>根据条件动态显示/隐藏表单项：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-typescript" lang="typescript"><span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> formItems = <span class="hljs-title function_">computed</span>(<span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> [
  {
    <span class="hljs-attr">label</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'用户类型'</span>,
    <span class="hljs-attr">key</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'userType'</span>,
    <span class="hljs-attr">type</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'select'</span>,
    <span class="hljs-attr">props</span>: {
      <span class="hljs-attr">options</span>: [
        { <span class="hljs-attr">label</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'个人'</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">value</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'personal'</span> },
        { <span class="hljs-attr">label</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'企业'</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">value</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'enterprise'</span> }
      ]
    }
  },
  {
    <span class="hljs-attr">label</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'企业名称'</span>,
    <span class="hljs-attr">key</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'companyName'</span>,
    <span class="hljs-attr">type</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'input'</span>,
    <span class="hljs-comment">// 只有选择企业类型时才显示</span>
    <span class="hljs-attr">hidden</span>: formData.<span class="hljs-property">value</span>.<span class="hljs-property">userType</span> !== <span class="hljs-string">'enterprise'</span>
  }
])
</code></pre>
<h4 data-id="heading-41">📏 灵活布局</h4>

<pre><code class="hljs language-typescript" lang="typescript"><span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> formItems = [
  {
    <span class="hljs-attr">label</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'用户名'</span>,
    <span class="hljs-attr">key</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'userName'</span>,

    <span class="hljs-attr">type</span>: <span class="hljs-string">'input'</span>,

    <span class="hljs-attr">span</span>: <span class="hljs-number">24</span> <span class="hljs-comment">// 占整行</span>

<h3 data-id="heading-42">5.3 与 ArtSearchBar 的区别</h3>



































<table><thead><tr><th>特性</th><th>ArtSearchBar</th><th>ArtForm</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>使用场景</td><td>表格搜索</td><td>表单提交、弹窗</td></tr><tr><td>展开/收起</td><td>✅ 支持</td><td>❌ 不支持</td></tr><tr><td>按钮文案</td><td>搜索/重置</td><td>提交/重置</td></tr><tr><td>样式</td><td>卡片样式</td><td>无背景</td></tr><tr><td>默认布局</td><td>横向排列</td><td>横向排列</td></tr></tbody></table>
<h2 data-id="heading-43">六、完整示例</h2>
<p>让我们看一个完整的用户管理页面：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-vue" lang="vue">&lt;template&gt;
  &lt;div class="user-page art-full-height"&gt;
    &lt;!-- 搜索栏 --&gt;
    &lt;ArtSearchBar
      v-model="searchForm"
      :items="searchItems"
      @search="handleSearch"
      @reset="resetSearchParams"
    /&gt;

    &lt;ElCard class="art-table-card" shadow="never"&gt;
      &lt;!-- 工具栏 --&gt;
      &lt;ArtTableHeader v-model:columns="columnChecks" :loading="loading" @refresh="refreshData"&gt;
        &lt;template #left&gt;
          &lt;ElButton @click="handleAdd"&gt;新增用户&lt;/ElButton&gt;

        &lt;/template&gt;

      &lt;/ArtTableHeader&gt;

      &lt;!-- 表格 --&gt;
      &lt;ArtTable
        :loading="loading"
        :data="data"
        :columns="columns"
        :pagination="pagination"
        @selection-change="handleSelectionChange"
        @pagination:size-change="handleSizeChange"
        @pagination:current-change="handleCurrentChange"
      /&gt;
    &lt;/ElCard&gt;

    &lt;!-- 弹窗 --&gt;
    &lt;UserDialog
      v-model:visible="dialogVisible"
      :type="dialogType"
      :user-data="currentUserData"
      @submit="handleDialogSubmit"
    /&gt;
  &lt;/div&gt;

&lt;/template&gt;

&lt;script setup lang="ts"&gt;
  import { useTable } from '@/composables/useTable'
  import { fetchGetUserList } from '@/api/system-manage'
  import UserDialog from './modules/user-dialog.vue'

  // 搜索表单
  const searchForm = ref({
    userName: undefined,
    userPhone: undefined,
    status: '1'
  })

  // 搜索项配置
  const searchItems = [
    {
      label: '用户名',
      key: 'userName',
      type: 'input',
      placeholder: '请输入用户名',
      clearable: true
    },
    {
      label: '手机号',
      key: 'userPhone',
      type: 'input',
      props: { placeholder: '请输入手机号', maxlength: '11' }
    },
    {
      label: '状态',
      key: 'status',
      type: 'select',
      props: {
        placeholder: '请选择状态',
        options: [
          { label: '在线', value: '1' },
          { label: '离线', value: '2' },
          { label: '异常', value: '3' }
        ]
      }
    }
  ]

  // 表格配置
  const {
    data,
    columns,
    columnChecks,
    loading,
    pagination,
    getData,
    searchParams,
    resetSearchParams,
    handleSizeChange,
    handleCurrentChange,
    refreshData
  } = useTable({
    core: {
      apiFn: fetchGetUserList,
      apiParams: {
        current: 1,
        size: 20,
        ...searchForm.value
      },
      columnsFactory: () =&gt; [
        { type: 'selection' },
        { type: 'index', width: 60, label: '序号' },
        {
          prop: 'avatar',
          label: '用户名',
          width: 280,
          formatter: (row) =&gt; {
            return h('div', { class: 'user-info' }, [
              h(ElImage, { src: row.avatar }),
              h('div', [h('p', row.userName), h('p', { class: 'email' }, row.userEmail)])
            ])
          }
        },
        { prop: 'userGender', label: '性别' },
        { prop: 'userPhone', label: '手机号' },
        {
          prop: 'status',
          label: '状态',
          formatter: (row) =&gt; {
            const config = getStatusConfig(row.status)
            return h(ElTag, { type: config.type }, () =&gt; config.text)
          }
        },
        {
          prop: 'operation',
          label: '操作',
          width: 120,
          fixed: 'right',
          formatter: (row) =&gt;
            h('div', [
              h(ArtButtonTable, {
                type: 'edit',
                onClick: () =&gt; handleEdit(row)
              }),
              h(ArtButtonTable, {
                type: 'delete',
                onClick: () =&gt; handleDelete(row)
              })
            ])
        }
      ]
    }
  })

  // 搜索处理
  const handleSearch = (params) =&gt; {
    Object.assign(searchParams, params)
    getData()
  }

  // 新增
  const handleAdd = () =&gt; {
    dialogType.value = 'add'
    dialogVisible.value = true
  }

  // 编辑
  const handleEdit = (row) =&gt; {
    dialogType.value = 'edit'
    currentUserData.value = row
    dialogVisible.value = true
  }

  // 删除
  const handleDelete = (row) =&gt; {
    ElMessageBox.confirm('确定要删除该用户吗？', '提示', {
      type: 'warning'
    }).then(() =&gt; {
      // 调用删除接口
      // await deleteUser(row.id)
      ElMessage.success('删除成功')
      refreshData()
    })
  }
&lt;/script&gt;

</code></pre>
<h2 data-id="heading-44">七、性能优化</h2>
<h3 data-id="heading-45">7.1 智能防抖</h3>
<p>搜索时自动防抖，避免频繁请求：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-typescript" lang="typescript"><span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> { getDataDebounced } = <span class="hljs-title function_">useTable</span>({
  <span class="hljs-attr">performance</span>: {
    <span class="hljs-attr">debounceTime</span>: <span class="hljs-number">300</span> <span class="hljs-comment">// 300ms 防抖</span>
  }
})

<span class="hljs-comment">// 使用防抖搜索</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">handleSearch</span> = (<span class="hljs-params"></span>) =&gt; {
  <span class="hljs-title function_">getDataDebounced</span>()
}
</code></pre>
<h3 data-id="heading-46">7.2 请求取消</h3>
<p>切换页面或快速切换搜索条件时，自动取消上一个请求：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-typescript" lang="typescript"><span class="hljs-comment">// useTable 内部实现</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">let</span> abortController = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">AbortController</span>()

<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">fetchData</span> = <span class="hljs-keyword">async</span> (<span class="hljs-params"></span>) =&gt; {
  <span class="hljs-comment">// 取消上一个请求</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">if</span> (abortController) {
    abortController.<span class="hljs-title function_">abort</span>()
  }

  <span class="hljs-comment">// 创建新的控制器</span>
  abortController = <span class="hljs-keyword">new</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">AbortController</span>()

  <span class="hljs-comment">// 发起请求</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">apiFn</span>(params)
}
</code></pre>
<h3 data-id="heading-47">7.3 缓存统计</h3>
<p>实时查看缓存状态：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-typescript" lang="typescript"><span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> { cacheInfo } = <span class="hljs-title function_">useTable</span>({
  <span class="hljs-attr">performance</span>: { <span class="hljs-attr">enableCache</span>: <span class="hljs-literal">true</span> }
})

<span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">log</span>(cacheInfo.<span class="hljs-property">value</span>)
<span class="hljs-comment">// { total: 10, size: '45KB', hitRate: '8 avg hits' }</span>
</code></pre>
<h2 data-id="heading-48">八、最佳实践</h2>
<h3 data-id="heading-49">8.1 目录结构</h3>
<pre><code class="hljs language-plain" lang="plain">views/
  system/
    user/
      index.vue           # 主页面
      modules/
        user-search.vue   # 搜索组件
        user-dialog.vue   # 弹窗组件
</code></pre>
<h3 data-id="heading-50">8.2 搜索组件封装</h3>
<p>使用 ArtSearchBar 封装搜索组件：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-vue" lang="vue">&lt;!-- user-search.vue --&gt;
&lt;template&gt;
  &lt;ArtSearchBar
    ref="searchBarRef"
    v-model="formData"
    :items="formItems"
    @reset="handleReset"
    @search="handleSearch"
  /&gt;
&lt;/template&gt;

&lt;script setup lang="ts"&gt;
  const formData = defineModel({ required: true })
  const emit = defineEmits(['search', 'reset'])

  const formItems = [
    {
      label: '用户名',
      key: 'userName',
      type: 'input',
      placeholder: '请输入用户名',
      clearable: true
    },
    {
      label: '手机号',
      key: 'userPhone',
      type: 'input',
      props: { placeholder: '请输入手机号', maxlength: '11' }
    }
  ]

  const handleSearch = () =&gt; {
    emit('search', formData.value)
  }

  const handleReset = () =&gt; {
    emit('reset')
  }
&lt;/script&gt;

</code></pre>
<h3 data-id="heading-51">8.3 类型安全</h3>
<p>充分利用 TypeScript 的类型推导：</p>
<pre><code class="hljs language-typescript" lang="typescript"><span class="hljs-comment">// API 类型定义</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">declare</span> <span class="hljs-keyword">namespace</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">Api</span>.<span class="hljs-title class_">SystemManage</span> {
  <span class="hljs-keyword">interface</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">UserListItem</span> {
    <span class="hljs-attr">id</span>: <span class="hljs-built_in">number</span>
    <span class="hljs-attr">userName</span>: <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span>
    <span class="hljs-attr">userPhone</span>: <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span>
    <span class="hljs-attr">userEmail</span>: <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span>
    <span class="hljs-attr">status</span>: <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span>
    <span class="hljs-attr">avatar</span>: <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span>
  }

  <span class="hljs-keyword">interface</span> <span class="hljs-title class_">UserSearchParams</span> {
    userName?: <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span>
    userPhone?: <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span>
    status?: <span class="hljs-built_in">string</span>
  }
}

<span class="hljs-comment">// useTable 会自动推导类型</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> { data } = <span class="hljs-title function_">useTable</span>({
  <span class="hljs-attr">core</span>: {
    <span class="hljs-attr">apiFn</span>: fetchGetUserList <span class="hljs-comment">// 返回 Promise&lt;UserListItem[]&gt;</span>
    <span class="hljs-comment">// data 的类型自动推导为 UserListItem[]</span>
  }
})
</code></pre>
<h2 data-id="heading-52">九、对比传统方案</h2>
<h3 data-id="heading-53">传统方案（约 200 行代码）</h3>
<pre><code class="hljs language-typescript" lang="typescript"><span class="hljs-comment">// 需要手动管理的状态</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> loading = <span class="hljs-title function_">ref</span>(<span class="hljs-literal">false</span>)
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> data = <span class="hljs-title function_">ref</span>([])
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> total = <span class="hljs-title function_">ref</span>(<span class="hljs-number">0</span>)
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> currentPage = <span class="hljs-title function_">ref</span>(<span class="hljs-number">1</span>)
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> pageSize = <span class="hljs-title function_">ref</span>(<span class="hljs-number">20</span>)
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> searchForm = <span class="hljs-title function_">ref</span>({})

<span class="hljs-comment">// 需要手动实现的方法</span>
<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">fetchData</span> = <span class="hljs-keyword">async</span> (<span class="hljs-params"></span>) =&gt; {
  loading.<span class="hljs-property">value</span> = <span class="hljs-literal">true</span>
  <span class="hljs-keyword">try</span> {
    <span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> res = <span class="hljs-keyword">await</span> api.<span class="hljs-title function_">getUserList</span>({
      <span class="hljs-attr">current</span>: currentPage.<span class="hljs-property">value</span>,
      <span class="hljs-attr">size</span>: pageSize.<span class="hljs-property">value</span>,
      ...searchForm.<span class="hljs-property">value</span>
    })
    data.<span class="hljs-property">value</span> = res.<span class="hljs-property">records</span>
    total.<span class="hljs-property">value</span> = res.<span class="hljs-property">total</span>
  } <span class="hljs-keyword">catch</span> (error) {
    <span class="hljs-variable language_">console</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">error</span>(error)
  } <span class="hljs-keyword">finally</span> {
    loading.<span class="hljs-property">value</span> = <span class="hljs-literal">false</span>
  }
}

<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">handleSizeChange</span> = (<span class="hljs-params">val</span>) =&gt; {
  pageSize.<span class="hljs-property">value</span> = val
  currentPage.<span class="hljs-property">value</span> = <span class="hljs-number">1</span>
  <span class="hljs-title function_">fetchData</span>()
}

<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">handleCurrentChange</span> = (<span class="hljs-params">val</span>) =&gt; {
  currentPage.<span class="hljs-property">value</span> = val
  <span class="hljs-title function_">fetchData</span>()
}

<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">handleSearch</span> = (<span class="hljs-params"></span>) =&gt; {
  currentPage.<span class="hljs-property">value</span> = <span class="hljs-number">1</span>
  <span class="hljs-title function_">fetchData</span>()
}

<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">handleReset</span> = (<span class="hljs-params"></span>) =&gt; {
  searchForm.<span class="hljs-property">value</span> = {}
  currentPage.<span class="hljs-property">value</span> = <span class="hljs-number">1</span>
  <span class="hljs-title function_">fetchData</span>()
}

<span class="hljs-comment">// ... 还有更多代码</span>
</code></pre>
<h3 data-id="heading-54">使用 useTable（约 30 行代码）</h3>
<pre><code class="hljs language-typescript" lang="typescript"><span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> {
  data,
  columns,
  loading,
  pagination,
  searchParams,
  getData,
  resetSearchParams,
  handleSizeChange,
  handleCurrentChange
} = <span class="hljs-title function_">useTable</span>({
  <span class="hljs-attr">core</span>: {
    <span class="hljs-attr">apiFn</span>: fetchGetUserList,
    <span class="hljs-attr">apiParams</span>: { <span class="hljs-attr">current</span>: <span class="hljs-number">1</span>, <span class="hljs-attr">size</span>: <span class="hljs-number">20</span> },
    <span class="hljs-attr">columnsFactory</span>: <span class="hljs-function">() =&gt;</span> [
      <span class="hljs-comment">/* 列配置 */</span>
    ]
  }
})

<span class="hljs-keyword">const</span> <span class="hljs-title function_">handleSearch</span> = (<span class="hljs-params">params</span>) =&gt; {
  <span class="hljs-title class_">Object</span>.<span class="hljs-title function_">assign</span>(searchParams, params)
  <span class="hljs-title function_">getData</span>()
}
</code></pre>
<p><strong>代码量减少 85%，功能更强大！</strong></p>
<h2 data-id="heading-55">十、总结</h2>
<p>这套表格开发方案的核心优势：</p>
<ol>
<li><strong>开发效率提升 10 倍</strong> - 从 200 行代码减少到 30 行</li>
<li><strong>功能更强大</strong> - 缓存、防抖、多种刷新策略、列配置等</li>
<li><strong>类型安全</strong> - 完整的 TypeScript 支持</li>
<li><strong>易于维护</strong> - 统一的代码风格和最佳实践</li>
<li><strong>用户体验好</strong> - 响应式设计、智能缓存、流畅交互</li>
</ol>
<p>如果你也在开发后台管理系统，强烈建议尝试这套方案。它不仅能让你的代码更简洁，还能让你有更多时间专注于业务逻辑，而不是重复造轮子。</p>
<p>如果这篇文章对你有帮助，欢迎点赞收藏！有任何问题也欢迎在评论区讨论 💬</p></div></div>
